Title: Finalize offline rebuild architecture
Body:
## Objective
Adopt one source of truth for the deterministic offline visualizer.

## Scope
- Confirm ConstantQNRT and Sequencer time as the supported analysis path.
- Confirm the initial line layout and instanced-mesh rendering approach.
- Record retired and deferred legacy systems.
- Record deterministic seek and failure-handling requirements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The architecture document names the runtime components and their boundaries.
- Every Stream MVP delivery card is consistent with the offline-only decision.
- Custom CQT and live audio are not prerequisites for the MVP.

## Dependencies
- None.

## Evidence
- Link `planning/documents/offline_visualizer_architecture.md`.

Title: Define response math and golden test vectors
Body:
## Objective
Specify deterministic conversion from raw ConstantQNRT values to visual response values.

## Scope
- Define noise-floor, normalization, band-weight, exponent, and clamp operations.
- Define safe behavior for invalid settings and non-finite input.
- Create representative input/output vectors for later automated tests.
- Defer stateful attack/release smoothing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Operation order and formulas are unambiguous.
- Boundary cases include silence, threshold, midpoint, peak, NaN, and infinity.
- Expected outputs can be checked without opening Unreal.
- Repeated evaluation of the same input has the same output.

## Dependencies
- D01 Finalize offline rebuild architecture.

## Evidence
- `planning/documents/response_math_spec.md`.
- `planning/test-vectors/response_golden_vectors.csv`.
- `python3 planning/scripts/validate_response_vectors.py`: PASS for 32 cases.

Title: Define deterministic layout contracts and test vectors
Body:
## Objective
Specify pure layout behavior for line, circle, and Fibonacci-sphere modes.

## Scope
- Define inputs, coordinate conventions, ordering, scale, spacing, and orientation.
- Define behavior for zero and invalid instance counts.
- Create reference transforms for small known counts.
- Defer spiral layout until its intended shape is specified.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each layout returns exactly one finite transform per requested band.
- Reference transforms cover counts 0, 1, 2, and a representative full layout.
- Circle radius and sphere radius can be verified numerically.
- Results do not depend on actor or world state.

## Dependencies
- D01 Finalize offline rebuild architecture.

## Parallel Work
- May run in parallel with D02.

## Evidence
- `planning/documents/layout_spec.md`.
- `planning/test-vectors/layout_golden_vectors.csv`.
- `python3 planning/scripts/validate_layout_vectors.py`: PASS for 17 cases and 29 transforms.

Title: Define Unreal runtime API and source structure
Body:
## Objective
Turn the architecture and pure behavior contracts into implementation-ready Unreal interfaces.

## Scope
- Define `ARTCQTVisualizer`, response settings, response processor, and layout APIs.
- Define ownership and asset-reference types.
- Define the explicit song-time update method.
- Define logging and missing-asset behavior.
- Draft the clean runtime-module file tree and dependency list.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every public property and method has one documented responsibility.
- Runtime code has no editor-module dependency.
- The API supports isolated frame evaluation and backward seeks.
- Implementation tasks can proceed without inventing new architecture.

## Dependencies
- D02 Define response math and golden test vectors.
- D03 Define deterministic layout contracts and test vectors.

## Evidence
- `planning/documents/unreal_runtime_api_spec.md`.
- Reviewed interface and build drafts in `planning/header-drafts/`.
- D02 and D03 reference validators remain passing.

Title: Prepare approved test audio and asset manifest
Body:
## Objective
Select and document the short audio source used for deterministic verification.

## Scope
- Select a 30-60 second WAV owned or cleared for the intended use.
- Record source, permission, duration, channels, sample rate, and bit depth.
- Define three or more reference timestamps with recognizable events.
- Decide whether the binary belongs in Git LFS or external storage.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Permission and provenance are recorded.
- The WAV meets the agreed technical format.
- Reference timestamps are documented.
- The storage location is recoverable.

## Dependencies
- D01 Finalize offline rebuild architecture.

## Parallel Work
- May run in parallel with D02-D04.

## Evidence
- `planning/documents/test_audio_manifest.md` records permission, provenance, technical identity, storage policy, and six reference timestamps.
- `planning/scripts/extract_wav_segment.py` recreates the exact 60-second fixture from the ignored full source.
- `planning/scripts/analyze_test_audio.py` verifies the fixture metadata, SHA-256, and signal checkpoints.
- Fixture SHA-256: `818bc64d830301e32fc929bfa19fb4799b23295e22bdde4e0108826554eb8a23`.

Title: Create recoverable Unreal project shell
Body:
## Objective
Create the complete current-Unreal project context missing from this checkout.

## Scope
- Record the exact Unreal Engine version.
- Create the C++ project and clean runtime module.
- Enable Audio Synesthesia and Movie Render Queue.
- Preserve `.uproject`, target files, `Config/`, and source.
- Configure storage rules for binary assets.
- Keep legacy source outside the new runtime module.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Development Editor build succeeds.
- The editor opens after a clean close and restart.
- Runtime build rules contain no editor-only modules.
- Another clone or backup contains the complete project shell.

## Dependencies
- D04 Define Unreal runtime API and source structure.

## Evidence
- `planning/documents/unreal_project_baseline.md`.
- UE 5.8 Development Editor build: Succeeded.
- Interactive close/reopen and required-plugin checks: Passed.
- Fresh NTFS clone build and headless editor load: Passed.

Title: Import test audio and create ConstantQNRT asset
Body:
## Objective
Create the supported pre-analyzed input for the first visualizer.

## Scope
- Import the approved WAV into `Content/Audio/`.
- Create a ConstantQNRT asset with the chosen 32- or 48-band configuration.
- Query raw band values at the manifest reference timestamps.
- Record analyzer settings and returned value counts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The SoundWave plays in the editor.
- ConstantQNRT analysis completes without an editor error.
- Raw values are available at every reference timestamp.
- Asset settings and band count are recorded.

## Dependencies
- D05 Prepare approved test audio and asset manifest.
- D06 Create recoverable Unreal project shell.

## Evidence
- Asset settings screenshot and timestamp query results.

Title: Implement static instanced line layout
Body:
## Objective
Render exactly one reusable mesh instance per configured band before connecting audio.

## Scope
- Add the visualizer actor and one instanced static mesh component.
- Implement the D03 line-layout contract.
- Rebuild instances only when layout inputs or band count change.
- Handle missing mesh and zero bands safely.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Instance count exactly matches the configured band count.
- Transforms match D03 reference vectors.
- No per-band actors are spawned.
- Missing assets produce a safe empty state and one actionable log.

## Dependencies
- D03 Define deterministic layout contracts and test vectors.
- D06 Create recoverable Unreal project shell.

## Parallel Work
- May run in parallel with D07 after D06 completes.

## Evidence
- Automated results, actor/component screenshot, and editor capture.

Title: Implement stateless response processor
Body:
## Objective
Implement the agreed deterministic spectrum-to-response transformation.

## Scope
- Implement the D02 operation order in plain C++.
- Add safe settings validation and non-finite input handling.
- Add automated checks using the golden vectors.
- Keep the processor independent of UObject, rendering, and playback.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All D02 golden vectors pass.
- Output remains finite and within documented bounds.
- Identical input and settings produce identical output.
- No prior-frame state is stored.

## Dependencies
- D02 Define response math and golden test vectors.
- D06 Create recoverable Unreal project shell.

## Parallel Work
- May run in parallel with D07 and D08 after D06 completes.

## Evidence
- Test output and implementation review.
Work Location: Unreal workstation or remote with configured UE toolchain

Title: Connect ConstantQNRT queries to explicit song time
Body:
## Objective
Drive raw frequency-band values from one authoritative time input.

## Scope
- Add an explicit update method accepting song time in seconds.
- Query ConstantQNRT at that exact time.
- Handle negative time, end-of-track time, missing assets, and band mismatches.
- Capture raw values at the reference timestamps.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The method does not use accumulated DeltaTime as song time.
- Repeated calls at the same timestamp return matching raw values.
- Seeking backward and forward does not retain analyzer state.
- Captured values match the D07 references.

## Dependencies
- D07 Import test audio and create ConstantQNRT asset.
- D08 Implement static instanced line layout.

## Evidence
- Timestamp captures from repeated and out-of-order queries.

Title: Drive mesh scale with deterministic response
Body:
## Objective
Map queried analyzer values through the response processor into bounded instance transforms.

## Scope
- Connect D10 raw band values to D09 processing.
- Apply bounded Z scale while preserving base X and Y scale.
- Update existing instances without recreating them.
- Expose response settings as an Unreal data asset.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every queried band maps to exactly one instance.
- Silence and peaks stay within configured scale bounds.
- Repeated and out-of-order timestamp updates produce matching transforms.
- Settings changes refresh safely without recreating the actor.

## Dependencies
- D09 Implement stateless response processor.
- D10 Connect ConstantQNRT queries to explicit song time.

## Evidence
- Reference timestamp transforms and short editor capture.

Title: Build emissive material and exposure baseline
Body:
## Objective
Create a stream-readable material response without unstable exposure.

## Scope
- Create a material using per-instance custom data for response and band index.
- Map the response to bounded emissive intensity and color.
- Lock or deliberately configure scene exposure.
- Document custom-data slots and parameter ranges.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Emissive response follows the same deterministic value used for scale.
- Quiet, average, and peak frames remain readable.
- Exposure does not pump during the test segment.
- Instance count does not create one dynamic material per band.

## Dependencies
- D11 Drive mesh scale with deterministic response.

## Evidence
- Material documentation and stills from quiet, average, and peak timestamps.

Title: Build Sequencer-driven track-length scene
Body:
## Objective
Drive audio, visualizer time, camera, and output duration from one Level Sequence.

## Scope
- Create a Level Sequence matching the approved test range.
- Set explicit frame rate and resolution.
- Drive the visualizer's song-time input from sequence time.
- Add and frame the camera.
- Verify scrubbing at every reference timestamp.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Sequence duration matches the intended audio range.
- Scrubbing away and back reproduces reference visual states.
- Camera framing includes every instance.
- Audio playback is synchronized to the timeline but is not used as the visual clock.

## Dependencies
- D05 Prepare approved test audio and asset manifest.
- D11 Drive mesh scale with deterministic response.
- D12 Build emissive material and exposure baseline.

## Evidence
- Sequence settings and reference-timestamp screenshots.

Title: Render repeatability and synchronization proof
Body:
## Objective
Prove Movie Render Queue produces clean and repeatable output from the deterministic scene.

## Scope
- Save a Movie Render Queue preset.
- Render the same 30-second range twice.
- Compare start, middle, end, and manifest reference frames.
- Record output settings, duration, elapsed time, and any differences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Both renders complete without missing frames or editor overlays.
- Output duration matches the sequence range.
- Reference checkpoints match within a documented pixel or parameter tolerance.
- The preset reproduces the output after restarting the editor.

## Dependencies
- D13 Build Sequencer-driven track-length scene.

## Evidence
- MRQ preset, logs, two proof renders, and comparison notes.

Title: Produce and verify synchronized media file
Body:
## Objective
Combine the approved audio and repeatable visual render into the OBS-ready media file.

## Scope
- Encode the selected render into the delivery codec.
- Mux the approved master audio exactly once.
- Verify synchronization at the start, middle, end, and reference timestamps.
- Record video and audio metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The file plays completely without corruption.
- Video and audio durations agree within one frame or documented tolerance.
- All synchronization checkpoints pass.
- Loudness and peak levels are safe for the intended stream mix.

## Dependencies
- D14 Render repeatability and synchronization proof.

## Evidence
- Media metadata and synchronization notes.

Title: Build OBS scene with single audio path and fallback
Body:
## Objective
Play the verified media through OBS with predictable video and exactly one audio route.

## Scope
- Add the media as a Media Source.
- Configure activation, restart, and loop behavior.
- Select embedded or separately routed audio, never both.
- Configure canvas, output, frame rate, and color settings.
- Create a one-action fallback scene.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Scene activation starts at the expected frame.
- OBS meters show exactly one intended audio signal.
- A local recording preserves resolution, frame rate, and sync.
- Switching to fallback requires one operator action.

## Dependencies
- D15 Produce and verify synchronized media file.

## Evidence
- OBS settings, mixer screenshot, and local recording.

Title: Pass private stream rehearsal
Body:
## Objective
Validate the complete viewer path before public use.

## Scope
- Run an unlisted or private stream for at least one complete loop.
- Watch from a second device or account.
- Monitor dropped frames, encoder load, audio levels, and synchronization.
- Exercise fallback and recovery.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The complete loop reaches the viewer without interruption.
- No doubled audio, clipping, or visible drift is observed.
- OBS reports no unexplained render or encoding lag.
- Fallback and recovery both succeed.
- Discovered issues are captured as separate cards.

## Dependencies
- D16 Build OBS scene with single audio path and fallback.

## Evidence
- Rehearsal date, platform, OBS statistics, and viewer notes.

Title: Write live-show runbook and release checklist
Body:
## Objective
Make the proven stream workflow repeatable under time pressure.

## Scope
- Document preflight, go-live, scene switching, recovery, and shutdown.
- Record final media, OBS backup, and fallback locations.
- Add a post-show evidence and issue-capture checklist.
- Record the last successful rehearsal configuration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A dry run can be completed using only the runbook.
- All referenced paths and backups exist.
- The fallback has a known-good visual and audio state.
- The runbook identifies the configuration proven in D17.

## Dependencies
- D17 Pass private stream rehearsal.

## Evidence
- Reviewed runbook and completed dry-run checklist.
Work Location: Remote after rehearsal evidence is available

Title: Add circle and Fibonacci-sphere layouts
Body:
## Objective
Recover recognizable RTCQT layouts on the proven deterministic pipeline.

## Scope
- Implement the D03 circle and Fibonacci-sphere contracts.
- Preserve band ordering, response processing, and explicit song time.
- Add layout switching without recreating analysis state.
- Verify camera framing and a short MRQ range for both layouts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every band maps to one finite transform in each layout.
- Implementations match D03 reference vectors.
- Switching layouts does not alter analyzer or response values.
- Short MRQ tests complete for both layouts.

## Dependencies
- D14 Render repeatability and synchronization proof.

## Evidence
- Automated checks, layout stills, and MRQ proof clips.
